questions.solution: $\frac{\sin 3 B}{\sin B}=\frac{3 \sin B-4 \sin ^3 B}{\sin B}=3-4 \sin ^2 B=3-4\left(1-\cos ^2 B\right)=-1+\frac{4\left(a^2+c^2-b^2\right)^2}{4(a c)^2}=-1+\frac{\left(\frac{a^2+c^2}{2}\right)^2}{(a c)^2}=-1+\frac{\left(a^2+c^2\right)^2}{4(a c)^2}=(\frac{c^2-a^2}{2 a c})^2$

questions.q: Let $ABC$ be an acute-angled triangle and let $D$ be the mid-point of $BC$. If $AB = AD$, then $\dfrac{tanB}{tanC}$& equal
questions.solution:
In $∆ ABC, D$ be the mid-point of $BC$ and $AB = AD ⇒ \Delta ABD$ is isosceles.

Let $AM$ be the perpendicular drawn from $A$ to $BC$.

$∴ AM$ is perpendicular bisector of $BD$

$BM = MD$

$ln\Delta ABM, tanB = \dfrac{AM}{BM}$

$ln\Delta AMC, tanC = \dfrac{AM}{CM}$

$∴ \dfrac{tanB}{tanC} = \dfrac{CM}{BM} = \dfrac{3BM}{BM} = 3 \left[∵ CM = DM + CD\right]

questions.q: In a $\triangle \mathrm{ABC},$ if $\frac{\cos A}{\mathrm{a}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{B}}{\mathrm{b}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{C}}{\mathrm{c}},$ and the side $\mathrm{a}=2,$ then area of the triangle is
questions.solution: $\frac{\cos A}{a}=\frac{\cos B}{b}=\frac{\cos C}{c}\Rightarrow \frac{\cos \mathrm{A}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{A}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{B}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{B}}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{C}}{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C}}\Rightarrow \cot A=\cot B=\cot C\Rightarrow \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{B}=\mathrm{C}=60^{{}^{\circ}} \Rightarrow \Delta \mathrm{ABC}$ is equilateral Hence, area of $\Delta=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \mathrma^{2}=\sqrt{3}$.
